title: Pkl Xcode generation must produce fresh, portable Concourse world-state without project.yml
description: Concourse project.yml and project.pkl currently have zero topology mismatches, and Vaporize can emit Xcode project world-state from the Pkl. That is not sufficient for Pkl ownership: the emitted project only resolves local package paths when placed beside project.pkl. At discovery, app build/install routing still read project.yml to infer the app bundle name and the emitted project lacked an XCRemoteSwiftPackageReference for Concourse's swift-snapshot-testing dependency; focused source patches now cover those renderer and Pkl-first routing slices, pending generated-project integration proof. The existing untracked concourse.generated.xcodeproj is stale, so reusing an old generated project would hide source-to-world-state drift. Until the remaining boundaries are closed, Pkl is a parity specimen rather than Concourse's canonical project-generation truth.
design: Make generate-xcodeproj own a fresh, deterministic world-state replacement: resolve relative source and local-package paths against the Pkl home (or rebase them for a declared output home), atomically replace its output rather than leaving stale project/workspace state, and record an input/output fingerprint in the generation receipt. Emit XCRemoteSwiftPackageReference plus matching XCSwiftPackageProductDependency records for url/from packages. Extend Vaporize's app build/install discovery to derive the bundle identity from evaluated AppleProjectSpec Pkl or an explicit typed app-bundle input, retaining project.yml only as a compatibility projection during the migration. Concourse's shared UI-test scheme is a Pkl product-spec declaration, not an inferred generator behavior; keep Pkl normative only after its declared app and test schemes build from freshly generated world-state.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh Concourse project generated from project.pkl resolves both its local packages and the remote swift-snapshot-testing package without a dangling PBX package reference.

The generated concourse app target builds with SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES using the source tree's current files, and the receipt records a generation input fingerprint plus the generated project path.

When Concourse declares its shared UI-test scheme in project.pkl, the generated scheme has a callable macOS test action and its target can resolve SnapshotTesting from the emitted remote package reference.

Vaporize app build/install routing can use evaluated Pkl project identity without reading project.yml; project.yml remains only an explicitly named compatibility projection until a separate retirement decision.
Generation safely replaces a prior output or rejects an unsafe output path; stale project/workspace artifacts cannot silently survive a new Pkl generation.

Focused standard Swift Testing coverage proves local-package, remote-package, output-freshness, and Pkl-derived app-bundle routing behavior; a live Concourse generated-project build is retained as integration evidence.

observedEvidence.observation: Generating the same Pkl project under /tmp made Xcode resolve relative local-package paths from the output project and fail at /service-universal/...; output placement currently changes semantics.
Concourse's remote swift-snapshot-testing dependency has a product dependency in the generated PBX but no emitted XCRemoteSwiftPackageReference, so the UI-test graph is incomplete.

observedEvidence.result: A focused Swift Testing target passed 2/2 cases: the Concourse swift-snapshot-testing url/from package emits XCRemoteSwiftPackageReference with upToNextMajorVersion 1.17.0, SnapshotTesting links to that object, and unpinned remotes are rejected. Fresh generated-project UI-test compilation remains required.

observedEvidence.observation: Vaporize app routing still consults project.yml for WRAPPER_NAME/app-bundle inference, preventing YAML retirement.

observedEvidence.result: The Pkl-first wrapper-name resolver resolves explicit Pkl, project-adjacent Pkl, workspace-adjacent Pkl, then source-root Pkl before project.yml compatibility fallback. Its target-only Swift Testing bundle passed 32/32 tests through direct xctest execution. The ordinary filtered swift test command remains blocked before CUJ-02 by existing CUJ-01 source-policy error CPPP001 at VaporizeCUJ01SwiftPMCLITests.swift:696; target-only execution is evidence for this slice, not a green global suite.

observedEvidence.command: <source-built-vaporize> generate-xcodeproj --pkl-path <concourse>/project.pkl --output-path <concourse>/.concourse-source-pkl-scheme-proof-<uuid>.xcodeproj --receipt-path <external-volume>/generation.receipt.json; GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=/Users/sonoma/mono/private xcodebuild -project <fresh-output>.xcodeproj -scheme concourse-tests-ui -configuration Debug -destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 -derivedDataPath <external-volume>/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES build
observedEvidence.result: The fresh source-built generator emitted the Concourse shared UI-test scheme, resolved swift-snapshot-testing as XCRemoteSwiftPackageReference, and the UI-test scheme compiled with xcodebuild exit=0 and BUILD SUCCEEDED. The external derived-data path was required because the system volume was nearly full; the installed Concourse app was not replaced or relaunched.

observedEvidence.command: GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=/Users/sonoma/mono/private xcodebuild -project <fresh-side-by-side-pkl-output>.xcodeproj -scheme concourse -configuration Debug -destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 -derivedDataPath /tmp/concourse-pkl-proof/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES build
observedEvidence.result: exit=0; BUILD SUCCEEDED; deploy phase printed 'Skipping /Applications deploy because SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES'. This proves only the app-target slice.

observedEvidence.command: GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES=/Users/sonoma/mono/private xcodebuild -project <fresh-side-by-side-pkl-output>.xcodeproj -scheme concourse-tests-ui -configuration Debug -destination platform=macOS,arch=arm64 -derivedDataPath /tmp/concourse-pkl-test-proof/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO SKIP_APPLICATION_DEPLOY=YES build
observedEvidence.result: exit=70; xcodebuild reported 'Unable to find a destination matching { platform:macOS, arch:arm64 }'. Reclassified after comparison: both tracked and generated projects lacked a shared concourse-tests-ui scheme, so this is a missing Concourse project-spec declaration rather than a Pkl platform-generation defect.

in: AppleProjectSpec Pkl to Xcode project rendering
Concourse as the live integration specimen
out: Installing, replacing, or relaunching the user's running Concourse application
Deleting Concourse project.yml before Pkl-generated app and test parity is demonstrated
A broad fleet migration beyond the Concourse proving ground
